text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the U.A.F. Test 
Tournament— The experience gained there 
began to show clear changes in <chrname>'s training 
results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Ryoka Tsurugi and the others 
extended a passionate invitation for the 
main event, expressing their high hopes 
for <chrname>'s success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The influence brought by the U.A.F. holds 
immense potential— a potential that leads 
toward a brighter future for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping it will positively impact future 
races, she decides to enter the 
tournament. At the same time, everyone's 
morale rises to make the event a success.
